column3: “leprous” renders “tsara'at,” a skin disease broader than modern leprosy.
“Lord” renders “Adonai” (also in verse 13), and “slow of speech and slow of tongue” renders “heavy of mouth and heavy of tongue.”
“send the message by whomever You will” renders “send by the hand You will send.”
“I will harden” renders “I will strengthen (make strong)” his heart.
“him” is unclear in the Hebrew, which may refer to Moses or his son.
“at Moses' feet” renders “at his feet,” and the episode is obscure.
